title: Geo map
description: A real map (Natural Earth borders, public domain) on a turning globe or a flat Mercator map. The camera pushes from the whole world into a place (country, continent, region like "Western Europe", city or "lat, lon"); highlighted countries fill with the accent, markers pop in 0.2 s apart with labels while the camera is still moving, routes draw between them as lifted flight arcs, and values per country colour a choropleth with a legend band. For news explainers, "where we operate", travel routes, launches by market and data maps.

projection.description: globe (orthographic, turns as it pushes in) or flat (Mercator, pans and zooms).

focus.description: Where the camera ends: a country, continent, Natural Earth subregion ("South America", "Western Africa"), city ("Lisbon", "Paris, France"), "lat, lon" or "world" (stay wide and turn). Empty: fit the markers, highlights and values.

start.description: Where the camera starts, same forms as focus (empty: the whole world, turned away a little so the globe spins in).

highlight.description: Countries or regions filled with the accent, one after another (the default is a Western Europe demo: pass [] for none).

markers.description: Places that get a pin, in the order they pop (cities, countries, "lat, lon"; the default is a Western Europe demo: pass [] for none).

labels.description: Label of each marker (empty or missing: the place's name; "-": no label).

route.description: Arcs between markers: none, path (each to the next, in order) or hub (the first to each of the others).

values.description: Choropleth: "Place=number" per country or region ("France=31", "Africa=12.5"); colours run from the land tone to the accent.

legend.description: Title of the colour legend (shown with values).

suffix.description: After the legend numbers, e.g. % or t.
